text:
Ava: Quick pulse — we need to lock the final go/no-go slot for release 3.8. Proposal: Tue Apr 5 09:00 PT (60m). Who can own canary, smoke, and post-cut monitoring? Also: confirm PM/UX rep and SRE on call.

Ravi: I can be canary owner. prefer earlier in the window but 09:00 works.

Marta: I can run staging smoke and the initial post-cut checks for 30m after cut.

Sam: Oncall that day, I can take ops handoff and pager escalation. Will need a second for longer-term metrics checks.

Ava: Awesome — adding names. Lina, can you be PM rep for the gate?

Lina: Yep, I'll be there and can run the acceptance checklist items.

Ravi: Quick ask — can we add a short RFC review (5m) at start to confirm toggle plan? I have one tiny change.

Ava: Good call. Draft agenda below — keeping it tight.

Ava: ```
Agenda (60m):
- 00:00 - 05:00  Quick RFC/toggle confirm (Ravi)
- 05:00 - 20:00  Canary rollout plan + owners (Ravi, Marta)
- 20:00 - 35:00  Smoke/runbook validation (Marta)
- 35:00 - 50:00  Ops handoff & monitoring plan (Sam)
- 50:00 - 60:00  Go/no-go decision + roll/abort steps (Ava, Lina)
Post-cut 30m: post-checks + metric sweep (Marta, Sam)
```

Marta: That looks good. For canary, I want to limit to 5% traffic initially, then 25% after 10m if no regressions.

Sam: Ops note — we need a rollback playbook link in the calendar invite and escalation contact list. I'll paste it in the doc.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite not yet created. To create invite, run `/cal create "3.8 final gate" 2026-04-05T16:00Z 60m eng-releases`.

Ava: Thanks — I'll create the invite now and add the rollback playbook and runbook links.

Ravi: I'm adding the toggle snippet to the RFC thread: https://redwood.internal/rfc/1142

Marta: Can someone tag QA for quick sanity? @QA-team?

Sam: @QA-team pinged — they said Emma will join for the smoke.

Ava: Current roster for the invite: Ava (release lead), Ravi (canary), Marta (smoke + post-cut), Sam (ops/oncall), Lina (PM), Emma (QA). Any other critical stakeholders?

Lina: Can we add Security (brief signoff) — I'll ask Priya to join for the first 10m.

Ava: Added Priya (security) to the list. Final ask: if you cannot attend, leave availability or a delegate in this thread by EOD Monday so we can re-schedule or confirm coverage.

Ravi: All good from me.

Marta: Good.

Sam: Confirmed.

Ava: Invite created and sent. Title: "3.8 final gate — go/no-go". Calendar contains agenda + links + rollback playbook. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Calendar event created by Ava for 2026-04-05T16:00Z. Attendees: Ava, Ravi, Marta, Sam, Lina, Emma, Priya.

Ava: Thanks everyone — will post the final pre-cut checklist tomorrow morning. If anything changes, update this thread. :party-parrot:
